name: benbentwos-claude-marketplace
description: Personal collection of Claude Code plugins for documentation, development workflows, and productivity

plugins.name: feature-changelog
plugins.description: Helps maintain FEATURES.md and CHANGELOG.md documentation during development tasks

plugins.name: unreal-mcp-improver
plugins.description: Automatically detects, logs, and fixes SadTire MCP limitations in the background while users continue their main work

plugins.name: uem
plugins.description: Unreal Editor Manager - editor lifecycle management, AI-driven rebuilds, log analysis, and MCP integration for UE5

plugins.name: prd-manager
plugins.description: Manage Product Requirements Documents (PRDs) to gate feature development behind structured requirements and track implementation status

plugins.name: context-docs
plugins.description: Automatically generate and maintain feature context documents that capture development knowledge so future AI sessions can quickly pick up where you left off

plugins.name: clarify-interview
plugins.description: Interviews you one question at a time about ambiguity during design and planning, prioritizing questions whose answer would change the architecture

plugins.name: decision-maker
plugins.description: Autonomous implementation decisions: picks the conservative non-destructive option and logs it under Deviations instead of stopping to ask, pausing only for destructive or architecture-altering forks

plugins.name: concise-tldr
plugins.description: An output style for terse, scannable updates in a what-changed / where-we're-at / what's-next form, written for someone who steps away mid-session and reads on re-entry
